name: The Spellbook
source:
A book that was found by mistake. A spell that was cast by stupidity... Shall be the beginning of an adventure!
Will you let things go out of hand?
Will you use it to all the women around you? Make them fall in love with you?
Or fail and lose everything?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/NaughtyGames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一本偶然发现的书，一道因愚蠢而施放的咒语……将成为冒险的开端！
你会任由事态失控吗？
你会用它对身边所有女性施法，让她们爱上你吗？
还是会失败并失去一切？
